bic_trace_step.reason: In mana_ib_create_qp_rss(), if ib_copy_to_udata() fails on line 239, the control flow jumps to the 'fail' label on line 244. However, the error handling path at the 'fail' label (lines 250-258) only destroys the WQ objects and frees mana_ind_table, without disabling or cleaning up the vport steering configured by mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering() on line 232. This results in a resource leak of the configured vport steering.
